boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on the Route 104 / Niagara Scenic Parkway corridor, the main off-campus route connecting Niagara University with the gorge, falls, Lewiston, and Youngstown.

cards.title: Niagara Power Vista
cards.subtitle: Route 104 / Lewiston Road corridor
cards.notes: Stop in for the interactive hydropower exhibits and observation-oriented visit. The official visitor page lists free admission and parking at 5777 Lewiston Road.
cards.short_summary: A free hands-on stop focused on Niagara hydropower.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara Power Vista is at 5777 Lewiston Road, has more than 50 interactive exhibits, and offers free admission and parking.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily 9 a.m.–5 p.m. operation, with certain holiday closures.

cards.title: Whirlpool State Park
cards.subtitle: Niagara Scenic Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Use the rim-side park for river views, trailheads, or a picnic; stay on open marked routes and check the posted trail closure before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A free gorge-rim park with overlooks and trail access.
cards.evidence_claim: Whirlpool State Park is open year-round dawn to dusk, provides hiking trails and overlooks, and is free to enter and park.
cards.source_title: Niagara Falls State Park – Whirlpool Area
cards.access_notes: Open year-round, dawn to dusk. Trail 5 is currently closed because of fallen rocks and unstable conditions.

cards.title: Artpark State Park
cards.subtitle: Route 104 / Lewiston corridor
cards.notes: Plan a daytime walk around the park’s trails and gorge views, or check the official calendar for a concert, gallery, workshop, or festival program.
cards.short_summary: A Lewiston park pairing outdoor space with arts programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Artpark offers performing and visual arts programs, including concerts, installations, festivals, gallery exhibits, workshops, camps, hiking, and gorge views.
cards.access_notes: The park is open year-round; theatre programming is listed as May through September. Check individual event details before going.

cards.title: Fort Niagara State Park
cards.subtitle: Route 104 / Niagara Scenic Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Use the state-park grounds for the river-and-lake setting, then choose from the listed trails, playgrounds, picnic areas, or seasonal recreation facilities.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront state park near the historic fort grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Fort Niagara State Park has Lower Niagara River and Lake Ontario access, woodland trails, picnic grounds, playgrounds, a nature center, and seasonal recreation facilities.
cards.source_title: Niagara Falls State Park – Whirlpool Area
cards.access_notes: Review the state parks site for current facility and seasonal conditions.

cards.title: Old Fort Niagara
cards.subtitle: Route 104 / Niagara Scenic Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Choose a museum-focused outing and use the fort’s official site to plan around its historic buildings, collections, and scheduled interpretation.
cards.short_summary: A preserved historic fort and museum complex in Youngstown.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Fort Niagara identifies itself as a historic fort and museum near Niagara Falls, New York.
cards.access_notes: Consult the fort’s official visitor information for current admission and programming.

cards.title: Aquarium of Niagara
cards.subtitle: Route 104 / Niagara Scenic Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Make this a weather-independent stop and use the aquarium’s own visitor pages to select an exhibit-focused visit or a scheduled animal program.
cards.short_summary: An indoor Niagara Falls attraction centered on aquatic animals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aquarium of Niagara is an operating public aquarium in Niagara Falls, New York with visitor programming and animal exhibits.
cards.access_notes: Check the aquarium’s official site for current admission, hours, and program availability.

cards.title: Maid of the Mist
cards.subtitle: Route 104 / Niagara Scenic Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Use the operator’s schedule and directions pages to plan a Falls boat excursion, including boarding timing and the current ticket requirements.
cards.short_summary: A ticketed boat voyage operated at Niagara Falls.
cards.evidence_claim: Maid of the Mist’s official site provides ticketing, schedule and pricing, planning, directions, and information about its boats.
cards.access_notes: Tickets are required; confirm the current operating schedule and pricing with the operator.

cards.title: Niagara Falls State Park
cards.subtitle: Route 104 / Niagara Scenic Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Use the state park as the gateway for a falls-side walk and choose only the open, maintained areas and attractions that fit your available time.
cards.short_summary: The state-managed park surrounding the American Falls.
cards.evidence_claim: Niagara University states that its campus is four miles north of the world-famous waterfalls and identifies Niagara Falls State Park as a local attraction.
cards.source_title: Niagara University — So Much to Do
cards.access_notes: Check the state park’s official channels for attraction-specific access and conditions.

cards.title: Joseph Davis State Park
cards.subtitle: Route 104 / Lewiston corridor
cards.notes: Bring a day-use plan for the park’s Lower Niagara River setting and use the state information to focus on the habitats, trail, or inclusive playground.
cards.short_summary: A Lower Niagara River park with habitats and new accessible play space.
cards.evidence_claim: New York State Parks announced a one-mile multi-use trail and an inclusive playground at Joseph Davis State Park in Lewiston.
cards.source_title: New York State Parks Unveils Upgrades to Joseph Davis State Park
cards.access_notes: Use current state-park information to confirm day-of access and trail conditions.

cards.entity_name: Robert Moses Niagara Power Plant Fishing Pier
cards.title: Robert Moses Niagara Power Plant Fishing Pier
cards.subtitle: Lewiston Road / Niagara Scenic Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Pair a Power Vista visit with the nearby named fishing pier if it is open; call the listed number for seasonal status before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A named fishing facility below the Robert Moses Niagara Power Plant.
cards.evidence_claim: The New York Power Authority lists a Fishing Pier at the base of the Robert Moses Niagara Power Plant and directs visitors to call for updates.
cards.access_notes: NYPA states the fishing pier opens seasonally and advises visitors to call 716-286-6662 for updates.
